title: Hitchhiker effect at Fugal's home: dog growling at 3 a.m.

tellings.quote: 3:00 a.m. or so, he would get up and start growling and barking at something that wasn't there, that was unseen,

plain: In 2024 the family dog at Brandon Fugal's home began getting up around 3 a.m. to growl and bark "at something that wasn't there, that was unseen." Fugal, the owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for reports of strange events, tells Michels this happened in his own house and credits a woman he calls Kristen. He tells it as an example of the "hitchhiker effect", the idea that whatever is on the ranch can follow people home.
